title: Oven Roasted Italian Lamb Cassata
description: A tangy and festive Italian dish featuring lamb, allspice berries, and traditional earthenware cooking, wrapped in banana leaves for a unique flavor and presentation. This recipe is tamasic-friendly and perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine lamb, allspice berries, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Lay a banana leaf flat on a work surface and place a quarter of the lamb mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the leaf over the filling to form a square package, and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Place the packages in a large earthenware dish or a Dutch oven with a lid.
Cover the dish with a lid or foil and roast for 2 hours and 30 minutes.
Remove the lid or foil and continue roasting for an additional 30 minutes, or until the lamb is tender and the leaves are caramelized.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
